# Original network wire fixtures

These 49 synthetic cases contain 98 original Source/JAR request and response streams.
The qualified capture is .workflow-local/network-wire-source-a/characterization.json.
Source, Source, and supplied JAR matched all bytes and observable handler rows.
The capture used memory streams and paused reference worlds; it did not exercise TCP peers.
Null and wrong-class payloads record legacy behavior requiring explicit Rust rejection.
Genotypes include shared Gene references, nonopaque ARGB, negative zero, and raw UTF-16.
All data derives from the supplied GPL-2.0-or-later Color Mod reference.
No personal save, external peer, or secret supplies fixture data.
